note: Clayton County Conservation; new campground opened May 2025 at Osborne Park (CCB offices/nature center) S of Elkader off Hwy 13, reached by the campground road south of the native animal exhibit. Volga River runs through the park but campsites sit back near the nature center, not on the bank. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm 20 RV sites, water + electric, showers, dump, $25 + $4, 14-day max, 3-night holiday min (now in min_stay). Count 27 -> 20 RV; season May 1-Oct 31 added. Amperage unstated. Not waterfront holds, imagery predates the campground.
flags: PIN and WATERFRONT unverifiable from imagery: the Esri tiles predate the 2025 campground and show only forest around the stored pin (a conifer plantation, no loop or pads). The stored pin equals the county's own page coordinates (42.7892072,-91.446306). The page says enter by the main park entrance and take the campground road south of the native animal exhibit, consistent with this. 'See map for locations' points to a county map I didn't find. Not waterfront stays by default; the county only says the Volga 'runs through the park'.
SITE COUNT: 27 was 20 + 7 tent (RV Life also 27). The 7 tent sites aren't on the pages read; dropped from the count as a 23-ft motorhome can't use them either way.
